Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Quick follow-up + hosted quickstart details for GreenCart

Hi Ava / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Fit recap: Hosted API looks like the most straightforward path for your initial pilot given you want fast time-to-value and don't have strict data residency requirements for the pilot. Dedicated or Private (VPC) still on the table if you need throughput guarantees or locked-down networking later.

2) Technical follow-ups you asked about: endpoints available, rate limits, and quickstart steps — I'm attaching a short checklist and our current hosted endpoint ratecard. Marcus (cc'd) will confirm exact per-endpoint rate/throughput numbers for your traffic pattern.

3) Proposed next steps:
 - Marcus to send the hosted endpoint and rate guidance by EOD tomorrow.
 - We run a short sandbox trial (2 weeks) on the hosted API with your sample traffic profile.
 - After sandbox, we assess whether a Dedicated pool or VPC is required for production.

Can you confirm that the sandbox timeframe works and whether you want us to include any additional telemetry or sample prompts for quality monitoring?

Thanks,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Sandbox: 2 weeks sounds good. We'd like the sandbox to include both the chat endpoint (for customer support flows) and embeddings (for product search).
- Rate limits: high-level QPS and burst behavior matter — our traffic during peak sales hours can spike and we need to understand throttling/backoff behavior.
- Data: Pilot data can go to hosted but we need assurances around logs retention and optional log redaction. Can Marcus confirm how logs are stored/retained and whether we can opt out of storing prompts?

Also copying Samir — he manages infra and will have precise traffic numbers. We'll share a short CSV of representative traffic by EOD.

Best,
Ava
Head of Product | GreenCart

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@greencart.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@greencart.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted endpoints, rate guidance, and quickstart notes

Hi Ava / Samir —

Following up with the technical details we discussed. High-level answers first, then sandbox checklist items.

1) Endpoints available for the hosted evaluation:
 - /v1/chat/completions — optimized for multi-turn support flows, streaming supported.
 - /v1/completions — single-turn generation for notifications/templates.
 - /v1/embeddings — vector embeddings for search & reranking.
 - /v1/rerank — optional, used for re-scoring candidate responses.

2) Typical hosted rate defaults and burst behavior (pilot-friendly):
 - Default per-account sustained: 60 requests/minute per endpoint (soft limit).
 - Default burst: up to 150 requests/minute for short 30s windows, subject to fair-use shaping.
 - Token throughput: approximately 10k tokens/minute sustained across endpoints for pilot tiers.
 - If you expect peak sustained QPS > the defaults, we recommend either Dedicated capacity or increasing hosted quotas for the sandbox (we can provision a temporary uplimit).

3) Throttling & backoff behavior:
 - 429 responses include Retry-After header. Client should implement exponential backoff with jitter.
 - For streaming chat, partial payloads are returned; the client should gracefully reconnect and resume if a connection is broken.

4) Data / logs retention options:
 - Default: request metadata and logs retained for 30 days for debugging and quality monitoring.
 - Opt-out: we can enable prompt redaction for your account and/or reduce retention to 7 days for sandbox. For production with longer retention requirements we can discuss contractual terms.

5) Sandbox quickstart checklist (what we'll provision for the 2-week trial):
 - Host a sandbox API key with scoped endpoints (chat + embeddings).
 - Temporary increased rate quota: sustained 200 rpm and burst 500 rpm for 2 weeks (subject to SOC checks).
 - Sample telemetry: latency percentiles, token usage, 429 events, and a small prompt-eval set we can run nightly.
 - Monitoring hooks: we will add tracing headers you can return to map requests to your logs.
 - Support: an SLA-free sandbox with 2 business-day response; we can schedule a mid-sandbox sync after 1 week.

6) Next steps (technical):
 - Samir sends the traffic CSV.
 - We provision the sandbox key and temporary quotas within 24–48 hours of receiving the CSV.
 - Diego will confirm any commercial credits with Marissa and loop back.

Attachments: greencart-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (detailed steps), endpoint-ratecard.csv (current hosted defaults).

If you want tighter isolation or committed throughput beyond the sandbox, we can run a Dedicated proof-of-concept; happy to outline differences in a separate note.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
